findings.detail: The purported deterministic seeded perturbations are not identical per item across exports or independent of item row ordering. A single sequential RNG generates a noise tensor in row order, so inserting/reordering rows changes the perturbation assigned to an existing item. This violates the specified item-stable seeded export behavior.
findings.reproduction: Call stability_tokens on embeddings [a,b] and then on [b,a] with same seed/train_ids and the same quantizer; outputs associated with each item can differ because the RNG stream is consumed in row order. Likewise append an unused row before a and its sampled noise changes.
findings.correction: Generate noise from a deterministic per-item seed/key (or generate a fixed [item_id, draw, dimension] noise table keyed by frozen item id), preserving the same perturbations for each item regardless of batching/order.
